name: linux-files
description: Browse the whole Linux file system in columns, copy any path, and download files or zipped folders to your Mac.

settings.title: Download folder
settings.description: Optional. A folder shared with your Mac, as its path appears in Linux (e.g. /Users/you/Downloads if shared). Downloads are then always saved directly there, overriding the folder chosen in the page. Leave empty to choose in the page (Download folder… in the status bar); downloads then go to the chosen folder's Downloads subfolder.
